{{Top|leg|notitle=1}}
The '''Assault and Injuries Act (rev. 96.82)''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] law. Posting a private [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] without informing the [[Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations/Legends|Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations]] was in violation of this law.
